# Support

Emuqu is a solo-maintained app. There is no support team and no response-time
guarantee.

## Using the app

The in-app Help section is the primary reference — it covers what every metric
means, how the recovery score is built, and what the app does and does not
claim. [`docs/USERS_MANUAL.md`](../docs/USERS_MANUAL.md) is the same material in
long form.

## Something is wrong

**A security or privacy issue** — do not open an issue. Follow
[`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).

**A bug** — open an issue using the bug report form. The single most useful
thing you can include is what the app showed versus what you expected, with the
date and time of the recording, because sessions are addressed by date.

**A question about a number the app produced** — say which screen, what it
said, and what you think it should have said. Recovery scores are computed from
your own rolling baseline, so "the score seems low" is usually a question about
baseline history rather than about the score.

## What this app is not

Emuqu is a wellness and fitness tool. It is not a medical device, it is not
FDA-cleared, and nothing it displays is medical advice, diagnosis, or
treatment. If something about your health concerns you, talk to a clinician —
not to an issue tracker.
